remarks: Fantastic and charming centrally located 1BR condo featuring gleaming hardwood floors, gas heat, central air, and soaring 9' ceilings. Enjoy a full basement with abundant storage, plus a full-size washer and dryer. Excellent closet space, an updated fully applianced kitchen with gas range, microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator, and a modernized full bath. Bright and airy with oversized windows, freshly painted walls, and beautifully refinished wood floors. Walk to train, shopping, and dining. Includes reserved parking plus ample guest spots. Strong credit, stable employment, and solid references required.
